title: The Dolbeault geometric Langlands correspondence for type A groups beyond the elliptic locus
summary: In this paper, we prove a Dolbeault geometric Langlands equivalence for $\GL_r$ and for the Langlands dual pair $\SL_r/\PGL_r$ over an open locus of the Hitchin base which strictly contains the elliptic locus. This open locus contains the points corresponding to spectral curves with at worst type $A$ singularities, without any restriction on the number of irreducible components.
